The transaction is expected to close in early 2027, subject to customary closing conditions and regulatory approvals. Financial terms were not disclosed.

stories.title: McDonald's hires former McKinsey partner for strategy role
stories.summary: McDonald's has appointed former McKinsey partner Hannah Yankelevich as its U.S. vice president of strategy, effective December 1. She replaces Mike Shapiro, a company veteran of eight years. The move is part of a leadership overhaul intended to address slowing domestic demand and shifting consumer spending habits.

stories.title: Bain report finds AI search is changing retail traffic
stories.summary: Bain & Company analyzed over 4,400 shopping prompts to find that AI agents now prioritize category specialists over traditional market leaders. One-third of US and European consumers now use AI for shopping. Retailers not appearing in AI-generated answers risk losing traffic, awareness, and potential sales.

stories.title: Accenture report finds AI content can alienate consumers
stories.summary: Accenture's Life Trends 2027 report claims 56 percent of Indian respondents view brands using AI for content as lazy, careless, or cheap. The study suggests consumers are increasingly seeking distinctive voices and direct human connections as machine-generated content becomes more common. Authenticity is now a measurable metric.

stories.title: McKinsey report links sustainability to cash flow
stories.summary: Sustainability risks and opportunities could impact long-term free cash flow by up to 20 percent of EBITDA, according to a McKinsey report. The firm suggests sustainability is now a core business priority influencing growth and competitiveness, requiring direct oversight from CEOs rather than secondary management.

stories.title: McKinsey claims agentic AI cuts planning time
stories.summary: A McKinsey report states that agentic AI can reduce business planning workloads by 83 percent and forecast errors by 50 percent. The firm suggests that combining predictive AI with autonomous agents allows companies to move from periodic forecasting to continuous decision-making. Efficiency is now automated.

stories.title: McKinsey claims agentic AI slashes planning errors
stories.summary: McKinsey reports that agentic AI can reduce forecast errors by 50 percent and cut planning hours by 83 percent. The findings, based on a single implementation at a life sciences company, suggest organizations can move away from periodic forecasting. The report does not mention the cost of implementation.

Teneo adds energy expertise with Granowski hire
stories.summary: Teneo has appointed Mike Granowski as a senior managing director in its energy and infrastructure practice. Based in Chicago, Granowski joins from Roland Berger with over 25 years of experience in utilities and nuclear energy. He will focus on strategy and transaction initiatives for the firm.

stories.title: Mace Consult names Mario Sawaya president for Americas
stories.summary: Mace Consult has appointed Mario Sawaya as president for the Americas. Based in Seattle, Sawaya will oversee the construction consultancy's regional operations and existing portfolio, which includes projects like the Hudson Tunnel. He brings two decades of experience in the architecture and engineering sector to the role.

Steer acquires maritime consultancy Mercator International
stories.summary: International consultancy Steer has acquired Kirkland-based Mercator International to expand its advisory presence in the ports and freight sectors. Mercator will continue to operate under its existing name within Steer's North America division. The acquisition adds maritime infrastructure expertise to Steer's current advisory capabilities.

Steer buys US-based maritime advisor Mercator
stories.summary: UK-based Steer has acquired the US consultancy Mercator, which specializes in port and maritime transaction advisory. Since 2000, Mercator has completed over 150 commercial due diligence projects. The firm will integrate its expertise in infrastructure and freight into Steer's global operations.

stories.title: Finyx Group acquires Birmingham consultancy Entec Si
stories.summary: Finyx Group has acquired Entec Si, a Birmingham-based firm focused on technology and business change. Founded in 1996, Entec Si provides transformation strategy and programme management, primarily to local government and non-profit sectors. The firm employs a core team of approximately 20 professionals.

stories.title: Tanabe Consulting Group acquires US firm Actus
stories.summary: Japanese management consultancy Tanabe Consulting Group has acquired a majority stake in New York-based Actus Consulting Group. The firm specializes in human capital services for Japanese companies operating in the United States. Actus has worked with over 1,000 Japanese businesses since its founding in 2002.

stories.title: Teneo hires Mike Granowski for energy practice
stories.summary: Teneo has hired Mike Granowski as a senior managing director for its energy and infrastructure team. Granowski previously led the North American energy and utilities platform at Roland Berger. He will advise clients on strategic and transaction matters involving nuclear power and gas sectors.

stories.title: BCG projects growth for India consumer durables
stories.summary: A report by Boston Consulting Group and the Confederation of Indian Industry projects India's consumer durables market will reach Rs 3 lakh crore by 2030. Growth is attributed to rising incomes and financing access. The report notes that a significant share of demand may still be met by imports.

stories.title: EngenX promotes industrial AI for factory efficiency
stories.summary: EngenX is marketing its industrial digital twin platform to manufacturers, citing the need for predictive maintenance and real-time intelligence. The company aims to assist India in increasing the manufacturing sector's contribution to GDP to 25 percent by 2035 through machine learning and data analytics.

stories.title: BCG report forecasts $1.2 trillion capital goods market
stories.summary: A joint report by the Confederation of Indian Industry and Boston Consulting Group projects India's capital goods market could reach $1.2 trillion by 2047. Growth is expected from investments in semiconductors and data centers. The report highlights that imports currently meet over one-third of domestic demand.

stories.title: India's capital goods industry poised for $1-$1.2tn by 2047 - NewsBytes
India capital goods market growth projected to 2047
stories.summary: The Confederation of Indian Industry and Boston Consulting Group project India's capital goods market will reach $1.2 trillion by 2047. Annual expenditure in electronics and semiconductors is expected to quadruple by 2029. Data centers are identified as a primary driver for demand in specialized industrial equipment.

stories.title: Schneider Electric and BCG partner on AI manufacturing
stories.summary: Schneider Electric and Boston Consulting Group have formed a collaboration to promote AI-enabled smart manufacturing in India. The initiative uses a Model Smart Factory approach to help manufacturers scale Industry 4.0 solutions. The partnership aims to address rising operational complexity and energy costs.

stories.title: Schneider Electric and BCG partner on smart manufacturing
stories.summary: Schneider Electric and Boston Consulting Group have entered a strategic collaboration to accelerate AI-enabled smart manufacturing in India. The companies plan to combine manufacturing capabilities with digital transformation expertise to help firms implement Industry 4.0 technologies. India aims to become a developed economy by 2047.

stories.title: Modi’s Manufacturing Mission Is Only Half Done - Bloomberg.com
BCG ranks India as an AI rising contender
stories.summary: Boston Consulting Group has named India an AI Rising Contender in its 2026 maturity matrix. The firm credits the ranking to a large pool of skilled specialists and an IT workforce with experience structurally adjacent to supervising AI systems. The country is considered ready for AI adoption.

stories.title: RSB Group eyes 4,000 crore IPO
stories.summary: RSB Group is reportedly planning a draft red herring prospectus for a 4,000 crore rupee initial public offering in December. The company has appointed Axis Capital, Jefferies, and HSBC Securities to manage the issue. Five new investors recently acquired a minority stake in the firm.

stories.title: Campus placement offers rise alongside salary bars
stories.summary: Top recruiters including McKinsey, BCG, and Bain have returned to campuses for the Class of 2027. While average salary packages at institutions like SRCC have increased to 16.8 lakh rupees, the total number of offers has declined from 213 to 190 compared to the previous year.

stories.title: Boutique firms challenge major consultancies in hiring
stories.summary: Boutique consulting firms are increasingly competing with global strategy consultancies and the Big Four for talent at Indian business schools. More than 40 percent of students now prefer consulting roles, citing high compensation and brand value. The industry remains a primary career choice for management graduates.

stories.title: Business studies career pathways
stories.summary: Business studies graduates have access to diverse career paths ranging from financial analysis to entrepreneurship. Management consulting remains the highest-paying entry route for new graduates. Financial analysts currently earn a median salary of 102,740 dollars with job growth projected to outpace the national average through 2034.

stories.title: Accenture limits salary hikes while offering bonuses
stories.summary: Accenture has introduced performance-based bonuses of up to 26 percent for top-performing employees in India as part of its November 2026 rewards cycle. While bonuses are available, the company has largely limited base salary hikes and promotions. Performance ratings determine the specific payout percentage.

stories.title: Accenture and Google Cloud partner on AI education
stories.summary: Accenture LearnVantage and Google Cloud are launching AI education programs across 1,000 Indian institutions. The initiative will establish Centres of Excellence and AI labs to provide training in generative and agentic AI. Students who complete the assessments will receive certification for their participation.

stories.summary: The University of the West of Scotland has awarded an honorary doctorate to Accenture executive Nicola Rosa. The recognition follows a career spanning roles at companies including Google, Yahoo, and Spotify. Rosa currently leads generative AI studios for Accenture across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.
